text: Implemented additive SupportAwarePyramid3 in reframe4s-multiscale. PSFs carry explicit sigma/FWHM units and declared or complete-affine voxel-cell trace-equivalent provenance. Each level computes max(0,targetVariance-sourceVariance), records negative-variance clamping, evaluates an isotropic world Gaussian through the complete native affine (including reflection/shear), filters weighted values and support with zero padding, resamples both from native, and normalizes only above a declared threshold. Existing ScalarPyramid3 was unchanged. Evidence: multiscale JVM 10/10 and JS 10/10; sheared Gaussian ratios agree with direct world-distance formula at 2e-15; negative-blur path is exact with one tap; missing/NaN unsupported samples remain finite with explicit fractional/zero support; native-origin fine-level ratio agrees at 2e-15. Consumer parity: motion JVM 42/42, JS 39/39; Flashalign JVM 17/17, JS 17/17. Ownership 1126 unique names/64 canonical owners; PRD/build graph 27 nodes/94 edges; diff check clean. No MRI accuracy or runtime claim is made.
